subject: Restructure business routes into (dashboard) route group
description: Move all non-POS feature folders (activity, attendance, cashiers, customers, finance, ingredients, payroll, products, reports, settings, shifts, tables, transactions) under src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/ so a shared layout.tsx can wrap them with the sidebar shell, while pos/ stays outside the group and keeps its current mobile-only layout with no sidebar.
